seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Catonsville, Maryland for 2026: 5 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Catonsville celebrates with a volunteer-run Santa House beside the fire department, a holiday arts market and, next door in Arbutus, a firehouse Christmas parade and train garden.
celebrates: Catonsville's season centers on the Catonsville Santa House, a free tradition run by a committee that is part of the CMCA: a tree lighting on Saturday, November 28, then Santa visits on Friday evenings and Saturday afternoons through December. The Baltimore County Arts Guild holds its Holiday Market at the Catonsville Clubhouse on December 6, with Santa pictures, free train rides and a magic show. Nearby Arbutus adds a Christmas parade on December 12 and a firehouse train garden that runs into January. Sweetfrog shops in Catonsville also host Santa visits.
lastyear: Catonsville's holiday events are built on repeat traditions. The Santa House site calls its tree lighting and Santa visits a beloved annual event that is free for residents and visitors. The 2026 Arts Guild Holiday Market is the third annual, so earlier markets ran in 2024 and 2025. In Arbutus, the 2026 firehouse train garden is the 31st or 32nd annual, depending on the page, so by the county's count it has run since the mid-1990s. Local choirs, school bands and teachers have filled the Santa House schedule.
facts: The Santa House schedule lists a school or community group each week, including the OLPH Chorus, Mt. St. Joseph and Mt. De Sales choirs, a Catonsville High School steel band and Hillcrest teachers reading holiday stories. St. Paul Lutheran Church hands out hot chocolate and popcorn on December 11. The Arbutus fire department's parade features the Mt. de Sales Academy Singers, Glen Burnie High School's marching band and UMBC's Down and Dirty Dawg Band.
trains: Catonsville families can catch trains close to home at the Old Fashioned Firehouse Christmas Garden in Arbutus, open from late November to January 2, and at the free outdoor train rides at the Arts Guild Holiday Market on December 6. For real rail history, the B&O Railroad Museum in Baltimore runs holiday trains. Our Baltimore guide lists the holiday train rides and dates.

faq: When is the Catonsville tree lighting in 2026?

The Catonsville Tree Lighting is Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 5:45 to 7 pm around the Catonsville Fire Department. The Santa House Committee lists live music, hot chocolate and cookies. Santa then sits in his house on Friday evenings from 6 to 8 pm and Saturday afternoons from 2 to 4 pm through December, on the dates in the committee's schedule.
Is the Catonsville Santa House free?

Yes. The Catonsville Santa House Committee says the tree lighting and Santa visits are free and open to residents and visitors. Hot chocolate and cookies are offered at the tree lighting, and entertainment such as carolers, choirs, a steel band and story readings is listed most weeks. There is no ticket and no registration on the committee's page.
Where is the Arbutus Christmas parade?

The Arbutus parade starts at Elm and Oregon, travels down East Drive and ends at the Arbutus Volunteer Fire Department on Southwestern Boulevard. It is Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 4:30 pm, with Santa, Mrs. Claus and the Grinch.
Is there a train garden near Catonsville?

Yes. The Arbutus Volunteer Fire Department's Old Fashioned Firehouse Christmas Garden is free, with donations appreciated, and runs from late November to January 2, 2027. Weekday hours are 6 to 8 pm and weekends are 11 am to 8 pm.
What else is nearby for kids?

Baltimore's Christmas Village, the B&O Railroad Museum and the Maryland Zoo are a short drive. Columbia and Ellicott City also have their own pages on this site with Christmas events for kids, with dates, prices and links to each host.
